relevant_controls_reviewed: G7 model-facing inputs must not expose private whole-proof/oracle material or routing strata.
G7 D0-D3 and V_ONLY/L_ONLY/U_ONLY are information interventions; oracle provenance must not be confused with endogenous model state.
U-ineligible cases remain in the denominator and U-dependent comparisons remain NOT COMPUTABLE rather than being silently treated as successes.
V/L/U/Q labels require independent verification; local structural checks do not establish Q mathematical validity or scientific truth.
Historical raw traces are immutable and a failed or contaminated batch cannot be retroactively repaired into confirmatory evidence.
